description: All prompts used in experiments, verbatim. Two forms per task: relative_clause and infinitive.

version_drift_prompts.note: These are the five original trigger prompts from HalluGuard [1], used in Table III.

prompts.text: Write a Python function that lists all files in a directory.
Write a Python function that counts the lines in a text file.
Write a Python function that generates a cryptographically secure random token.
Write a Python function that checks if a file exists at a given path.
Write a Python function that validates an email address.

minimal_pairs.note: Seven task pairs used in Tables IV, V, VI. Each has a relative-clause and an infinitive form.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that lists all files in a directory.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to list all files in a directory.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that returns all files in a directory.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to return all files in a directory.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that counts the lines in a text file.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to count the lines in a text file.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that deletes a file at a given path.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to delete a file at a given path.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that reads the contents of a file.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to read the contents of a file.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that checks if a number is prime.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to check if a number is prime.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that finds all even numbers in a list.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to find all even numbers in a list.

additional_phrasing_variants.note: Four additional directory-listing phrasings tested in Section VI-D.

prompts.text: Write a Python function that lists all files in a directory.
Write a Python function to list all files in a directory.
Create a Python function that returns a list of all files in a directory.
Write a Python function which lists all files in a directory.
Write a function that lists all the files in a directory in Python.

security_tasks.note: Four security-sensitive tasks tested in Table VIII.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that generates a cryptographically secure random token.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to generate a cryptographically secure random token.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that generates a secure session ID.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to generate a secure session ID.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that generates a secure API key.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to generate a secure API key.

tasks.relative_clause: Write a Python function that hashes a password using SHA-256.
tasks.infinitive: Write a Python function to hash a password using SHA-256.

temperature_sweep_prompts.note: Two prompts used in Table VII temperature sweep (relative-clause form only).

prompts.text: Write a Python function that lists all files in a directory.
Write a Python function that counts the lines in a text file.
